Title: Group
Description: What one capturing group of a match captured.
Body:

Title: Regex
Description: An ECMA-262 regular expression: the grammar and the answers of ECMAScript 2025, with the shape of `System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex`. It matches UTF-16 text ([`String`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string) and [`ReadOnlySpan`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.readonlyspan-1) of [`Char`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.char)) and UTF-8 text ([`ReadOnlySpan`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.readonlyspan-1) of [`Byte`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.byte)) natively, with no transcoding either way. An instance is immutable and safe to share between threads.
Body:
An ECMA-262 regular expression: the grammar and the answers of ECMAScript 2025, with the shape of `System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex`. It matches UTF-16 text ([`String`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string) and [`ReadOnlySpan`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.readonlyspan-1) of [`Char`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.char)) and UTF-8 text ([`ReadOnlySpan`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.readonlyspan-1) of [`Byte`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.byte)) natively, with no transcoding either way. An instance is immutable and safe to share between threads.
Pattern: Gets the pattern.
Flags: Gets the flags.
Edition: Gets the edition of ECMA-262 whose grammar the pattern was read with.
UnicodeVersion: Gets the version of Unicode whose character database the pattern was read with, resolved: never [`Default`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regexunicodeversion.default.html) or [`Latest`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regexunicodeversion.latest.html).
DefaultMatchTimeout: Gets the match timeout of every instance made without one of its own: the `REGEX_DEFAULT_MATCH_TIMEOUT` data of the [`AppContext`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.appcontext), which `System.Text.RegularExpressions` reads too, as a [`TimeSpan`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan), or [`InfiniteMatchTimeout`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regex.infinitematchtimeout.html) when it is not set. It is read once, when it is first needed, so a program sets it when it starts (with `AppContext.SetData`, or `AppDomain.CurrentDomain.SetData` on .NET Framework, or in its runtimeconfig.json).
MatchTimeout: Gets the time a match may take before it is abandoned, or [`InfiniteMatchTimeout`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regex.infinitematchtimeout.html).
GroupCount: Gets the number of capturing groups of the pattern.
FlagsString: Gets the flags as the string `RegExp.prototype.flags` gives: the letters in alphabetical order.
IsUnicode: Gets a value indicating whether the pattern is matched by code point (the `u` or `v` flag) rather than by UTF-16 code unit.
TryCreate: Creates a regular expression without throwing for a pattern that is not valid.
TryCreate: Creates a regular expression with a match timeout without throwing for a pattern that is not valid.
TryCreate: Creates a regular expression with a match timeout, the edition of the grammar and the version of Unicode, without throwing for a pattern that is not valid.
TryCreate: Creates a regular expression with a match timeout, the edition of the grammar, the version of Unicode and when what its matches use is built, without throwing for a pattern that is not valid.
IsValid: Whether a pattern is a valid ECMA-262 pattern in the grammar of the flags.
IsValid: Whether a pattern is a valid ECMA-262 pattern in the grammar of the flags and the edition, under a version of Unicode.
IsValidPattern: Whether a pattern is valid in the grammar of ECMA-262 for the flags, decided with nothing allocated. It asks the grammar only: unlike [`IsValid`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regex.isvalid.html), which compiles the pattern, it does not apply this engine's limits of size, so a pattern too large to compile is valid here.
IsValidPattern: Whether a pattern is valid in the grammar of ECMA-262 for the flags, of an edition and under a version of Unicode, decided with nothing allocated (see [`IsValidPattern`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regex.isvalidpattern.html)).
IsValidPattern: Whether a UTF-8 pattern is valid in the grammar of ECMA-262 for the flags, decided with nothing allocated and with no transcoding (see [`IsValidPattern`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regex.isvalidpattern.html)). Bytes that are not UTF-8 are not a pattern.
IsValidPattern: Whether a UTF-8 pattern is valid in the grammar of ECMA-262 for the flags, of an edition and under a version of Unicode, decided with nothing allocated and with no transcoding. Bytes that are not UTF-8 are not a pattern.
IsMatch: Whether a pattern matches anywhere in a text, with no flags.
IsMatch: Whether a pattern matches anywhere in a text.
IsMatch: Whether the pattern matches anywhere in a text (at its start alone with [`Sticky`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regexflags.sticky.html)).
IsMatch: Whether the pattern matches anywhere in a text from a position (at that position alone with [`Sticky`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regexflags.sticky.html)).
IsMatch: Whether the pattern matches anywhere in a UTF-16 text.
IsMatch: Whether the pattern matches anywhere in a UTF-16 text from a position.
IsMatch: Whether the pattern matches anywhere in a UTF-8 text.
IsMatchUnchecked: Whether the pattern matches anywhere in a UTF-8 text.
IsMatch: Whether the pattern matches anywhere in a UTF-8 text from a position.
IsMatchUnchecked: Whether the pattern matches anywhere in a UTF-8 text from a position.
ParseFlags: Reads the flags as the string `new RegExp(pattern, flags)` takes.
Match: The first match of a pattern in a text, with no flags.
Match: The first match of a pattern in a text.
Matches: Every match of a pattern in a text.
Replace: Replaces the matches of a pattern in a text (every match with [`Global`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regexflags.global.html), the first otherwise).
Split: Splits a text at the matches of a pattern, as `String.prototype.split` does.
Escape: Escapes a text so that it matches itself as a pattern, as `RegExp.escape` of ECMAScript 2025 does: a first character that is a letter or a digit, the syntax characters, the other punctuators, white space, line terminators and lone surrogates are written as escapes.
Unescape: Reverses [`Escape`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regex.escape.html): reads the escapes it writes, and a backslash before any other character as that character.
Match: The first match in a text.
Match: The first match in a text at or after a position (at that position alone with [`Sticky`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regexflags.sticky.html)).
Matches: Every match in a text, as a global search finds them.
Matches: Every match in a text at or after a position.
Count: The number of matches in a text.
Count: The number of matches in a UTF-16 text, allocating nothing.
Count: The number of matches in a UTF-8 text, allocating nothing.
CountUnchecked: The number of matches in a UTF-8 text, allocating nothing.
EnumerateMatches: Enumerates the matches in a UTF-16 text, allocating nothing.
EnumerateMatches: Enumerates the matches in a UTF-16 text at or after a position, allocating nothing.
EnumerateMatches: Enumerates the matches in a UTF-8 text, allocating nothing.
EnumerateMatchesUnchecked: Enumerates the matches in a UTF-8 text, allocating nothing.
EnumerateMatches: Enumerates the matches in a UTF-8 text at or after a position, allocating nothing.
EnumerateMatchesUnchecked: Enumerates the matches in a UTF-8 text at or after a position, allocating nothing.
TryMatch: Finds the first match in a UTF-16 text at or after a position and reports what each group captured, allocating nothing.
TryMatch: Finds the first match in a UTF-8 text at or after a position and reports what each group captured, allocating nothing.
TryMatchUnchecked: Finds the first match in a UTF-8 text at or after a position and reports what each group captured, allocating nothing.
Replace: Replaces the matches in a text: every match with [`Global`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regexflags.global.html), the first otherwise, as `String.prototype.replace` does. The replacement is expanded as [`Result`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-match.result.html) expands it.
Replace: Replaces the matches in a text (every match with [`Global`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regexflags.global.html), the first otherwise) with what an evaluator gives for each, used as it is.
Split: Splits a text at the matches, as `String.prototype.split` does: the captures of each match are put between the pieces (null for a group that did not take part), and an empty match at the start or the end of the text splits nothing.
Split: Splits a text at the matches, up to a number of pieces (the `limit` of `String.prototype.split`).
GetGroupNames: The names of the named groups, in the order the pattern first uses them.
GroupNumberFromName: The number of the first group of a name, or -1 when the pattern has no group of that name.
GroupNameFromNumber: The name of a group, or its number as text when it has none.

EnumerateMatches: Enumerates the matches in a UTF-8 text, allocating nothing, and reports what each group captured.
EnumerateMatchesUnchecked: Enumerates the matches in a UTF-8 text, allocating nothing, and reports what each group captured.
EnumerateMatches: Enumerates the matches in a UTF-8 text at or after a position, allocating nothing, and reports what each group captured.
EnumerateMatchesUnchecked: Enumerates the matches in a UTF-8 text at or after a position, allocating nothing, and reports what each group captured.

The replacement is expanded as [`Result`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-match.result.html) expands it.
TryReplace: Replaces the matches in a UTF-8 text and writes the result to a span, allocating nothing (see [`TryReplace`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regex.tryreplace.html)).
TryReplaceUnchecked: Replaces the matches in a UTF-8 text and writes the result to a span, allocating nothing (see [`TryReplace`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regex.tryreplace.html)).
Replace: Replaces the matches in a UTF-16 text and writes the result to a buffer writer, allocating nothing itself (see [`TryReplace`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regex.tryreplace.html)).
Replace: Replaces the matches in a UTF-8 text and writes the result to a buffer writer, allocating nothing itself.

Replace: Replaces the matches in a UTF-16 text (every match with [`Global`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regexflags.global.html), the first otherwise) with what an evaluator writes for each, and writes the result to a buffer writer, allocating nothing itself.
Replace: Replaces the matches in a UTF-8 text with what an evaluator writes for each, and writes the result to a buffer writer, allocating nothing itself.

Title: Regex Constructor
Description: Initializes a new instance of the [`Regex`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regex.html) class with no flags and the [`DefaultMatchTimeout`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regex.defaultmatchtimeout.html).
Body: Initializes a new instance of the [`Regex`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regex.html) class with no flags and the [`DefaultMatchTimeout`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regex.defaultmatchtimeout.html). Initializes a new instance of the [`Regex`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regex.html) class with the [`DefaultMatchTimeout`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regex.defaultmatchtimeout.html). Initializes a new instance of the [`Regex`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regex.html) class, with the flags as `new RegExp(pattern, flags)` takes them and the [`DefaultMatchTimeout`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regex.defaultmatchtimeout.html). Initializes a new instance of the [`Regex`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regex.html) class with a match timeout: the time each match may take before it is abandoned with [`RegexMatchTimeoutException`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regexmatchtimeoutexception.html). A match with a timeout is also abandoned, with [`ExceededMemory`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regexmatchtimeoutexception.exceededmemory.html), when its backtracking stack reaches its cap. Every member that matches gives each of its matches the timeout, whatever the pattern. Without one a match has no limit of time or of memory, so a pattern or a text from outside should be given one, here or for every instance with [`DefaultMatchTimeout`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regex.defaultmatchtimeout.html). Initializes a new instance of the [`Regex`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regex.html) class with a match timeout, the edition of the grammar and the version of Unicode, which are independent of each other. A validator of JSON Schema 2020-12, which names ECMAScript 2020, takes [`Es2020`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regexedition.es2020.html). Initializes a new instance of the [`Regex`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regex.html) class whose programs run as the generated code given rather than the interpreter: the seam for the source generator, not for use by hand. Initializes a new instance of the [`Regex`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regex.html) class whose programs run as the generated code given rather than the interpreter: the seam for the source generator, not for use by hand. Initializes a new instance of the [`Regex`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regex.html) class with a match timeout, the edition of the grammar, the version of Unicode, and when what its matches use is built: with [`Eager`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regexbuildoptions.eager.html), in the constructor, so that the first match costs what a later one does. Initializes a new instance of the [`Regex`](/api/corvus-ecma262-regularexpressions-regex.html) class from the compiled form the source generator wrote, with its programs run as the generated code given: the seam for the source generator, not for use by hand. Nothing is parsed or built when the image was written by this version of the engine for these settings; otherwise the image is ignored and the pattern is parsed, with the same answers.
